title: </sub>  Resolve repeated-run membership conflicts deterministically
text:
</sub>  Resolve repeated-run membership conflicts deterministically

When repeated sweep-on runs attribute the same underlying defect differently, this clause still provides no authoritative value: the fresh text only asserts that every run records the same cohort-level membership, while AC1/AC20 continue to create each pass record independently at review time, before cross-run defect identity is adjudicated. Implementations therefore cannot know which entry governs if one run categorizes the defect and another marks it uncategorized. Define a separate cohort-level adjudicated membership field or an explicit precedence rule rather than requiring independently produced records to agree.
